description: This file implements gesture recognition classes and methods, including Gesture, GestureDatabase, GesturePoint, and GestureStroke, for creating, normalizing, and comparing gestures.

classes.name: GestureDatabase
classes.description: Class to handle a gesture database, allowing adding gestures and finding matches.

classes.name: GesturePoint
classes.description: Represents a point in a gesture with x and y coordinates.

classes.name: GestureStroke
classes.description: Represents a stroke in a gesture, consisting of multiple points, with methods for scaling, normalizing, and measuring distance.

classes.name: Gesture
classes.description: Main class implementing gesture recognition, including normalization, comparison, rotation, and scoring.

methods.name: add_stroke
methods.description: Adds a stroke to the gesture, optionally with a list of points.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes the gesture by scaling and centering, and computes the dot product for comparison.

methods.name: get_score
methods.description: Returns a similarity score between this gesture and another, optionally rotation-invariant.
